inspection.method: Original PNG loaded directly, not a crop or prior modern output

facts.observation: A long lower plate has approximately horizontal top and bottom boundaries, short vertical ends, and extends farther left and right than the upper plate.

The upper thin plate rises gently toward the right in image-height coordinates: its underside is close to the lower top boundary at the left and is farther above that boundary toward the right. Both long edges have the same overall inclination; source stroke thickness and scan irregularity are not surface-roughness data.

The gap above the lower plate and below the upper underside is very narrow at the left and widens toward the right. A small dark, diagonally hatched spacer occupies the far-right part of that gap. The source contains no incident rays, reflected rays, drawn interference fringes, roughness profile, scale, or thickness annotation.
